purpose: Test whether the frozen Task14 direction×cardinality-0 upstream number writes are reusable on adjacent possessive-number behavior with a different output vocabulary and downstream task branch.

binding_program.selection: Cardinality 0 is registered before reuse outcomes because the adjacent possessive authority has no E/A/U/W background factors.

possessive_authority.selected_rows: All 64 answer-changing A1/A2 rows; P/C controls are excluded because they do not define the registered plural<->singular direction map.

novelty_audit: Searches for possessive prototype, prototype possessive, cross-task number write, upstream reuse possessive, and adjacent L11H3 found no prior event.
The possessive screen identifies controller-local behavior at resid:18 but does not test Task14 L11H3 computation reuse.
The prior collateral test establishes preservation on unrelated tasks; this test instead demands useful donorward transfer on a related number task with `their`/`his` outputs.
intervention: For each A1/A2 possessive base prompt, add the Task14 cardinality-0 projected L11H3 vector matching its registered plural-to-singular or singular-to-plural direction at the final prediction position. Measure the change in donor-answer minus base-answer logit margin. Compare with adding the opposite-direction cardinality-0 vector on the identical row. A zero-add replay validates the interface.

predictions.pred_a_authorities_and_program_validate: All immutable hashes, the possessive screen, exact row census, two finite 1152-D program vectors, and model checkpoint validate.
predictions.pred_b_native_capability_and_noop: All 64 selected base prompts favor their base possessive answer; exact zero-add replay changes answer/foil logits by <=1e-4 and projected-addition error is <=5e-5.
predictions.pred_c_correct_write_moves_possessive_ma: Correct-direction writes move donor-minus-base margin positively on >=75% of 64 rows and have median donorward change >=0.005 logits.
predictions.pred_d_each_direction_construction_trans: Each of four direction×construction cells has >=62.5% positive donorward changes and positive median change.
predictions.pred_e_direction_assignment_is_necessary: Correct-direction change exceeds swapped-direction change on >=65% of rows and median(correct-swapped) >=0.005 logits.
predictions.pred_f_literal_cross_task_reuse: Exactly 64 correct and 64 swapped unscaled installations are measured; no possessive outcome, gradient, fit, scale, offset, vector selection, or parameter update enters the writes.

null: Failure of c/d means the Task14 upstream write is not reusable for local possessive number. Failure of e means any effect is generic projected-write disturbance rather than direction-specific number computation. Preserve the null and do not tune cardinality or vector scale on these rows.
